Class InputSystem

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents the main input system for managing input devices, input actions, and access control. Handles device updates, action trees, and provides locking mechanisms for input processing.

Properties

CurrentInputActionDeviceType

Current InputAction based device type detected by ActiveInputActionTreeGroup. The first non-None InputDeviceType detected during the update of the ActiveInputActionTreeGroup is used.

public InputDeviceType CurrentInputActionDeviceType { get; }

Property Value

InputDeviceType

Remarks

For an InputActions IInputTypes InputDeviceType to be considered the following conditions must be met:

  • The InputAction must be part of an InputActionTree within the ActiveInputActionTreeGroup.
  • The InputAction must be active.
  • The IInputType's InputState must be down.
  • The IInputType must not be blocked (when BlocksInput is true).

Locked

Indicates if the input system is currently locked. When set to true, InputActions and other input requests will only be processed if they have the AllAccessTag or their access tag is contained in the lock whitelist. All InputActions and input request with an access tag contained in the lock blacklist will not be processed.

public static bool Locked { get; }

HasAccess(uint)

Determines if the specified access tag has access. AllAccessTag always returns true (has access).

  • If tag is contained in the current blacklist, this function will return false (no access).
  • If tag is not contained in the current blacklist and tag is contained in the current whitelist, or the current whitelist is empty, this function will return true (has access).
public static bool HasAccess(uint tag)

Lock()

Locks the input system, clearing all whitelists and blacklists. Only InputActions and input requests with AllAccessTag will be processed. 

public static void Lock()

Lock(BitFlag, BitFlag)

Locks the input system with a specific whitelist and blacklist. All InputActions and other input requests with a tag contained in the whitelist or with the AllAccessTag will be processed. All InputActions and other input requests with a tag contained in the blacklist will not be processed. 

public static void Lock(BitFlag whitelist, BitFlag blacklist)
